def calculate_signals(df):
    # Continuous Institutional Gold Session: London Open through US Floor Settlement (06:00 - 18:00 UTC)
    times = df.index if isinstance(df.index, pd.DatetimeIndex) else pd.to_datetime(df.get('dt', df.get('datetime', df.index)))
    mins = times.hour * 60 + times.minute
    sess = (6 * 60 <= mins) & (mins < 18 * 60)

    # Swing Highs and Lows
    sw_highs, sw_lows = find_swings(df, swing_len=10)

    # Daily Levels
    levels = daily_levels(df)

    # Volume Weighted Average Price
    vwap_line = vwap(df)

    # SSL and BSL Sweeps
    ssl_sweep = (df['low'] < sw_lows) & (df['close'] > sw_lows)
    bsl_sweep = (df['high'] > sw_highs) & (df['close'] < sw_highs)

    # Armed Long and Short Conditions
    armed_long = ssl_sweep.rolling(14, min_periods=1).max() == 1
    armed_short = bsl_sweep.rolling(14, min_periods=1).max() == 1

    # Exotic Indicator: Chandelier Exit
    long_stop, short_stop = chandelier_exit(df, period=22, mult=3.0)

    # Volatility Confluence: ATR Expansion
    atr_val = atr(df, 20)
    atr_expansion = (atr_val > atr_val.shift(1)) & (atr_val > atr_val.rolling(14).mean())

    # Raw Bull and Bear Conditions
    raw_bull = (armed_long & (df['close'] > vwap_line) & (df['close'] > levels['s1']) & atr_expansion & sess)
    df['bull_signal'] = raw_bull & (~raw_bull.shift(1).fillna(False))

    raw_bear = (armed_short & (df['close'] < vwap_line) & (df['close'] < levels['r1']) & atr_expansion & sess)
    df['bear_signal'] = raw_bear & (~raw_bear.shift(1).fillna(False))

    # Stop Loss Calculation
    df['sl_long'] = np.minimum(df['low'], sw_lows) - (1.8 * atr_val)
    df['sl_short'] = np.maximum(df['high'], sw_highs) + (1.8 * atr_val)

    # Risk Calculation
    risk_long = np.maximum(df['close'] - df['sl_long'], 4.00)
    risk_short = np.maximum(df['sl_short'] - df['close'], 4.00)

    # Take Profit Calculation
    df['tp1_long'] = df['close'] + (risk_long * 3.8)
    df['tp1_short'] = df['close'] - (risk_short * 3.8)


    # Risk Officer Injected Session Gating (London/NY Killzones)
    _sess_mask = session_mask(df, 'london_ny')
    if 'bull_signal' in df.columns:
        df['bull_signal'] = df['bull_signal'] & _sess_mask
    if 'bear_signal' in df.columns:
        df['bear_signal'] = df['bear_signal'] & _sess_mask

    return df

    # Continuous Institutional Gold Session: London Open through US Floor Settlement (06:00 - 18:00 UTC)
    times = df.index if isinstance(df.index, pd.DatetimeIndex) else pd.to_datetime(df.get('dt', df.get('datetime', df.index)))
    mins = times.hour * 60 + times.minute
    sess = (6 * 60 <= mins) & (mins < 18 * 60)

    # Swing Highs and Lows
    sw_highs, sw_lows = find_swings(df, swing_len=12)

    # Daily Levels
    levels = daily_levels(df)

    # VWAP
    vwap_line = vwap(df)

    # Volatility Squeeze Breakout
    bb_upper, bb_lower, bb_basis = bollinger_bands(df['close'], period=20, mult=2.0)
    keltner_upper, keltner_lower, keltner_mid = keltner_channels(df, ema_period=20, atr_period=14, mult=2.0)

    # Volatility Squeeze Condition
    vol_squeeze = (bb_lower > keltner_lower) & (bb_upper < keltner_upper)

    # SSL and BSL Sweeps
    ssl_sweep = (df['low'] < sw_lows) & (df['close'] > sw_lows)
    bsl_sweep = (df['high'] > sw_highs) & (df['close'] < sw_highs)

    # Orderflow Imbalance Tick Volume Ratio
    tick_volume_ratio = (df['volume'] / df['high'].diff().abs().fillna(0)).rolling(10).mean()

    # Armed Conditions
    armed_long = ssl_sweep.rolling(15, min_periods=1).max() == 1
    armed_short = bsl_sweep.rolling(15, min_periods=1).max() == 1

    # Raw Signals
    raw_bull = (armed_long & (df['close'] > vwap_line) & (df['close'] > levels['s1']) & (tick_volume_ratio > 1.2) & vol_squeeze & sess)
    df['bull_signal'] = raw_bull & (~raw_bull.shift(1).fillna(False))

    raw_bear = (armed_short & (df['close'] < vwap_line) & (df['close'] < levels['r1']) & (tick_volume_ratio > 1.2) & vol_squeeze & sess)
    df['bear_signal'] = raw_bear & (~raw_bear.shift(1).fillna(False))

    # Risk Management
    atr_val = atr(df, 14)
    df['sl_long'] = np.minimum(df['low'], sw_lows) - (1.8 * atr_val)

    df['tp1_long'] = df['close'] + (risk_long * 3.8)

    _sess_mask = session_mask(df, 'london_ny')
